blocks.text: Newsletter platform built for growth - with monetization from day one

beehiiv was built by the team behind Morning Brew's newsletter growth, and that expertise shows in every feature. While other newsletter platforms focus primarily on sending emails, beehiiv is obsessed with growth - referral programs, recommendation networks, SEO-optimized web pages, and audience analytics that help you understand what drives subscriptions.

The monetization options are what set beehiiv apart for creators and media companies. The built-in ad network connects you with advertisers, premium subscriptions let you gate exclusive content, and the boost network pays you for recommending other newsletters. Revenue generation is not an afterthought.

For businesses using newsletters as a marketing channel, beehiiv's segmentation and automation features let you personalize content based on subscriber behavior. Send different content to engaged vs. dormant subscribers, new vs. long-time readers, or segment by interest - all without complex email marketing tool configuration.
Referral programs, recommendation network, and SEO-optimized pages
Built-in marketplace connecting newsletters with advertisers
Gate content behind paid tiers for recurring revenue
Deep subscriber analytics including engagement scoring and attribution
Target content based on behavior, interests, and engagement level
Publish your newsletter on your own domain with full branding control
For anyone serious about building a newsletter audience, beehiiv provides the growth and monetization tools that other platforms lack. The referral system alone can transform subscriber acquisition.
Our team can integrate beehiiv into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
